'''Armageddon Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Imperial soldier]]s serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]]. In [[3640 BBY]], it was to be assigned to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to aid [[Darth Vowrawn]] in [[Battle of Corellia|battle]], but they were redirected to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[Darth Baras]] in order to undermine Vowrawn's campaign.<ref name="Reallocation" /> When the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] ordered [[General/Legends|General]] [[Greist]] to report to Darth Vowrawn on Corellia, the General refused, prompting the Wrath to execute him and give [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Phenter]] the same order. Phenter complied and ordered the unit to pack up.<ref name="Reallocation" />
